---
name: Field Guide correction
about: Report a wrong turn, missing item, encounter or missable
title: ''
---

**Game, edition and page**

Give the game, area and page title. A guide link also helps.

**What needs changing?**

Quote the few words that identify the problem. Give the correction in your own words.

**How can another player check?**

Give the starting point, direction of travel and what you observed. If you used a written reference, name the author and section. Keep spoilers out of the title and private game files, saves and firmware off the issue.
